Figure 2 : A Conceptual Overview of LLaDA. (a) Pre-training. LLaDA is trained on text with random masks applied independently to all tokens at the same ratio t ∼ U ​ [ 0 , 1 ] t\sim U[0,1] . (b) SFT. Only response tokens are possibly masked. (c) Sampling. LLaDA simulates a diffusion process from t = 1 t=1 (fully masked) to t = 0 t=0 (unmasked), predicting all masks simultaneously at each step with flexible remask strategies.
